summary: The Urban Wellness Collective is launching a workshop series starting September 10, 2023 to teach skills for building and maintaining healthy relationships in a changing, tech-heavy society. Each session, led by a different expert, covers a theme such as empathy, digital mindfulness, long-term commitment, boundaries, intergenerational understanding and workplace relationships. Additional November workshops will cover inclusive communication, mindfulness, conflict resolution and creative expression.
one_line: Urban Wellness Collective announces a future-focused fall 2023 workshop series on empathy, digital habits, commitment, boundaries, generational and workplace relationships.
key_facts: The Urban Wellness Collective is launching a series of workshops on healthy relationships, slated to commence on September 10, 2023.
Dr. Angela Hartley, a psychologist and relationship counselor, will spearhead the opening session and stresses forward-thinking strategies.
"Empathy in Action," scheduled for September 17, 2023, is facilitated by compassionate communication expert Michael Jonsson and incorporates emerging research on emotional AI.

"Digital Mindfulness: Harmony in Connectivity" on September 24, 2023 is led by digital wellness coach Maria Torres, who says technology can be a portal to new relationships or a barrier to deeper ones.

"Commitment and Growth in the Modern Age" on October 2, 2023 is led by relationship coach Patrick Lin, who emphasizes adaptability: "It's not just about making commitments; it's about evolving with them."
"Boundaries for a New Era" on October 9, 2023 is guided by Samantha Reid, a counselor specializing in self-care and personal growth, and aims to prevent relationship burnout.
"Unity Across Ages" on October 16, 2023 is co-facilitated by gerontologist Dr. Lucas Kim and youth counselor Jenna Thompson to build dialogue between age groups.
"Harmonizing Work Relationships" on October 23, 2023 is led by corporate wellness expert Dr. Emily Saunders, who forecasts that businesses prioritizing employees' relational wellness will flourish.
November workshops will cover inclusive communication, mindfulness in relationships, conflict resolution, and creative expression as pathways to connection.
Michael Jonsson predicts that empathy will become a prized currency in human interaction as artificial intelligence manages more daily tasks.
